toy.title: Raspberry Pi NeoPixels
toy.description: A TypeScript effects engine for WS281x LED strips on a Raspberry Pi, with live data modes, a guided CLI, and a fully tested core.

items.label: Weather
items.text: strip color tracks the current temperature, turns blue for rain, and pulses for NWS severe weather warnings and watches

items.label: Sunrise/Sunset
items.text: follows the real sun through dawn, daylight, and dusk, with an optional moon phase rendered across the strip at night

items.label: UV Index, Air Quality, and Space Weather
items.text: standard EPA/WHO color scales and NOAA geomagnetic storm levels, with pulsing alerts during storms
Location auto-detected by IP or entered by city

items.label: Classic effects
items.text: Solid, Checkerboard, Change, Blink, Breathe, Growing Bar, Wheel, and Walk Pixel

items.label: Custom Pixels
items.text: build multi-segment layouts interactively, pixel by pixel or by range

items.label: Pomodoro timer
items.text: a draining countdown bar with color-coded focus and break phases
Camera Module motion detection overrides the current effect with a chosen color
Gamma correction for perceptually accurate color and smooth fades

items.label: Shared polling architecture
items.text: pure frame builders, dependency-injected data sources, render-on-change, and graceful handling of network failures
Ctrl+C at any prompt exits safely and leaves the LEDs untouched
Develop on Mac with a no-op driver; run on the Pi with the real hardware
Extensive Jest test suite with fake timers and mocked hardware
SN74AHCT125 logic level shifter (3.3 V Pi → 5 V strip) with a series resistor on the data line for clean signaling
Individually addressable LEDs, suited to custom signs and 3D builds

contributions.label: Performance
